title: How a simple glass of tart cherry juice may quiet inflammation and lull you to sleep - Whatfinger News Quick Hits
text:
How a simple glass of tart cherry juice may quiet inflammation and lull you to sleep
Tart cherry juice is rich in anthocyanins, which are powerful antioxidants that reduce inflammation. Clinical studies show it can lower inflammatory markers, providing relief for conditions like osteoarthritis and gout and aiding muscle recovery after exercise.
As a natural source of melatonin and tryptophan, tart cherry juice helps regulate the sleep-wake cycle. Research, including gold-standard sleep studies, has demonstrated it can significantly increase total sleep time and efficiency, particularly in individuals with insomnia.
Regular consumption can contribute to cardiovascular health by leading to a modest reduction in systolic blood pressure and helping to lower levels of LDL (“bad”) cholesterol, addressing two key risk factors for heart disease.
Beyond its core benefits, early research suggests tart cherry juice may also support brain health and cognitive function, aid in blood sugar management and protect vision due to its high concentration of protective antioxidants.
Tart cherry juice is an evidence-informed dietary supplement, not a medicine. It should be integrated into a health regimen and not replace prescribed medications and potential interactions with drugs (e.g., blood thinners, sedatives) should be discussed with a doctor.
